translations.web: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.
translations.bsb: Though you grind a fool like grain with mortar and a pestle, yet his folly will not depart from him.
translations.kjv: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart
translations.asv: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with bruised grain, Yet will not his foolishness depart from him.
